Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 23
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the WebSurfer agent failed to verify the lyrics it found before declaring the task complete. After multiple failed attempts to access the lyrics due to CAPTCHAs and scrolling issues, the agent assumed the lyrics were successfully retrieved and that the line "Because he's sleeping with me" was the correct line preceding the second chorus. In reality, the lyrics of "Dirty Diana" do not contain this line before the second chorus; the actual line is "I'm gonna kill you" (or similar context depending on the specific version/lyric sheet, but definitely not "Because he's sleeping with me"). The agent prematurely concluded the task without cross-referencing the found text against known facts or ensuring the specific structural requirement (second chorus) was met, leading to an incorrect answer ("me" instead of the correct word). This matches the pattern of "Premature Conclusion" and "Assumption-Based Error" seen in Example 5.
